# SkillForge: Practical Project Management

Practical Project Management is SkillForge's flagship course for new and aspiring project leads. It focuses on the everyday skills needed to plan work, manage stakeholders and keep projects on track, with less theory and more hands-on practice than traditional certification programmes.

## Course format

The course is delivered online through a mix of short video lessons, weekly live workshops and a capstone project based on a real initiative from the learner's own workplace. Learners are placed in small cohorts so they can share experiences and give each other feedback.

FACT: SkillForge course lasts 6 weeks with about 4 hours of study per week.
FACT: SkillForge charges 750 dollars per learner.
FACT: SkillForge cohorts are limited to 20 learners.

## What you will learn

Topics include scoping and defining success, building realistic schedules, estimating effort, managing risk, running effective status meetings and communicating with senior stakeholders. The final weeks cover handling scope change and closing a project with a useful retrospective.

## Instructors

Every cohort is led by an experienced project manager who has delivered projects in technology, healthcare or public sector organisations. Instructors hold office hours each week and review each learner's capstone project in detail.

## Completion

Learners who attend at least five of the six live workshops and submit the capstone project receive a SkillForge certificate of completion. The course does not include an external certification exam, but its content aligns with widely used project management frameworks, which helps learners who plan to sit an exam later.

## Team enrolment

Organisations enrolling five or more learners receive progress reports and can request a private cohort scheduled around their working hours.
